walls.note: faces the gardens behind the Herengracht houses; no panorama, no public view. Drawn as the 3DBAG shell in the front brick.
Keizersgracht front, read from the frontal 2019 rectification (TMX7316010203-001543_pano_0000_002272, w02-193.alt.jpg) with tints from the sunlit 2023 crop. Symmetric about the carriage door.

items.where: middle of the ground storey, t 5.4-9.1 m, to 3.44 m
items.how: segmental-headed dark timber carriage door with glazed upper panels and vertical ribs, in a brick voussoir ring

items.where: two pairs of white pilasters either side of the carriage door (t 4.0-5.25 and 9.3-10.55 m) and one at each corner, on grey stone feet, under the white entablature (3.58-4.0 m)
outer bays of the ground storey, t 1.35-3.1 and 11.45-13.2 m
items.how: dark panelled double doors with glazed upper panels under a transom light in a white surround

items.where: beside each side door on the carriage-door side, about 2.3-2.9 m
items.how: a black bracket and a small glazed lantern box; the scrollwork of the bracket is left out

items.where: four white U-shaped iron hooks hanging under each side axis on the entablature
items.how: each hook as a white L of two thin bars

items.where: three axes over two storeys (4.07-6.47 and 7.17-8.61 m), side axes 1.7 m and the middle 1.9 m wide
items.how: white stone surrounds, dark-framed casements with a mullion and (first storey) a transom

items.where: French railings across the lower part of every window
items.how: black top and bottom rails with seven bars

items.where: a white projecting slab on two brackets over each first-storey window (6.52-7.17 m) and a flat capped hood over each upper window (8.61-9.21 m)
two bull's-eye windows between the axes at 6.69 m, t 4.56 and 9.98 m
items.how: round light in a white ring inside a brick ring

items.where: rusticated (banded) brick corner lesenes, t 0-0.94 and 14.0-15 m, from the entablature to the cornice
items.how: rustication kit: one brick block per 0.29 m course with V joints

items.where: the straight white cornice across the front, 9.52-10.7 m: architrave, plain frieze, projecting crown
three dormers on the cornice: the tall white stone middle one with a railing over the carriage axis (to 13.46 m, the 3DBAG dormer), two smaller white-framed ones with slate cheeks over the side axes
items.how: boxes with framed lights and projecting caps; the tops of all three are above the photos' frames, so the caps are inferred flat

items.where: small house-number and name plaques beside the doors

skip.note: plaques of about 20 cm do not read at riding distance
